title: A/R Summary has the Export menu with PDF and CSV
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has open customer documents and you want to export A/R Summary.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look along the title row and the filter row for a Print button.
  2. Hover over the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  3. Click the ⋯ button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no Print button (A/R's former Print button is gone).
  • Step 2: A/R Summary shows a ⋯ button at the right of its title row, labelled "Export report".
  • Step 3: the menu opens and offers "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • What changes for existing users: “A/R's Print button becomes the Export menu; its PDF prints the on-screen order and the as-of date the user picked (today it can print the next day's date).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
